name: Adzviser Adobe Analytics
description:
Connect your Adobe Analytics data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about page views, visits, and visitors. Compare pages, dig into browser and device performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Adobe Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Adobe Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://adobe-analytics.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Adobe Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Adobe Analytics provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_adobe_analytics, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Adobe Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Adobe Analytics in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Adobe Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Adobe Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Adobe Analytics is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
